overview: A multilingual government-style appointment booking portal for an electricity commercial office, with passkey sign-in, real-time slot availability, per-appointment QR codes, and an administrator check-in scanner.
features: Language selection in Kurdish Sorani, Arabic, and English with full right-to-left support
Customer registration with a unique verified phone number
Passwordless sign-in with passkeys and device biometrics
Account recovery and registered device management
Appointment booking with real server-side availability
A unique QR code for every appointment
Administrator-only QR scanner with server-side verification
Administrator check-in workflow with duplicate-scan protection
Role-based access control and an audit log
Service catalogue, office information, and appointment dashboard
